id: title:ablaszkiewicz:show os and browser pills on the stack trace bar

review.posthog_relevance: Exception card rendering and crash prevention in the frontend exception tracking visualization.
review.reason: The change updates snapshot hashes for cached comparison, adds regression tests for exception attribute extraction, and replaces direct property access with a helper that filters out non-string or empty values before use. This prevents potential runtime crashes in the exception card visualization when properties are missing or not strings, while also updating cached comparison keys
review.uncertainty: While the code demonstrates a clear correctness and reliability improvement, the actual runtime benefit and user impact depend on the frequency and severity of the edge cases handled, which are not independently verified. No production incident or adoption data is available.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed; only observations are returned.

observations.behavior: Snapshot hashes for exception-card error-tracking components were updated.
observations.posthog_connection: These are snapshot hashes used by the frontend visualizer; changing them does not change runtime behavior, only cached comparison results.

observations.behavior: Added tests for exception attribute extraction, including handling of non-string values and missing OS/browser properties.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds regression protection against crashes caused by non-string or missing properties in exception cards.

observations.behavior: Replaced direct property access with a helper that filters out non-string or empty values before use.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes exception attribute extraction to avoid passing non-string values to PropertyIcon, which could throw and crash the exception card.
